notes.title: New Game Out Now!
notes.notes:
Did you ever wonder what riding a unicycle in midair feels like? Well, you can give it a try in [b]Professor Doctor Jetpack[/b].

Our new game is now available on Steam! If you enjoy [b]Unimime - Unicycle Madness[/b], [b]Professor Doctor Jetpack[/b] is for you!

Join Albert Einstein's digital remains on his whacky quest to save the world from hidden threats, like The Internet. Fly your jetpack through 85+ handcrafted levels in an atmospheric pixel art environment.

And the best thing is, you can try it out for free. Just download the demo and fire up those jets:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470390/Professor_Doctor_Jetpack/

Have fun and as always, break a leg!

Clemens & Timo a.k.a. Roflcopter Ink
